_: headphones.webp: one row of cells per layer (2x a 176px card): walk frames, run frames, stand (still, waiting), look (still, under the pointer, the card a touch higher), hop; row 1 the ant, behind the card; row 2 its near arm and hand where they lie over the card, over it. walk, run: how many frames each; stand, look, hop: which frame. corner: where the card's lower-left corner goes in a cell; ground: where the walking feet are. lift: how far the card rises on each frame so the feet stay on the ground. steps, runSteps: px it goes on each walk and run frame. card: the card it is drawn for
